counter_arguments: The PR only adds a new test file for retry logic; it does not modify the charge amount handling code where the cap is applied.
The test exercises a charge of 5000 cents, well below the 50000‑cent cap, so it does not verify or change the capping behavior.
The PR description and diff contain no reference to the ledger migration (PAY-240) or to removing the cap, which is the required revisit condition.
Even if the test indirectly validates that charges succeed, it does not address the underlying overflow risk in the downstream ledger.
reasoning: The workaround HACK-008 is intended to prevent integer overflow in a downstream ledger by capping charge amounts at 50000 cents until the ledger is migrated to bigint (ticket PAY-240). The PR under review merely introduces unit tests for Stripe charge retry logic and does not modify the capping logic, the ledger migration, or any related code paths. Therefore, it does not satisfy the revisit condition and does not resolve the workaround.
